name: Roll hoop (Hana Roadster)
modelTodo: Hana Roadster roll hoop: a 45 mm tube hoop behind both seats, 120 cm wide and 75 cm tall, with two short braces back to the deck.
_note: A padded roll hoop behind the seats: a stiffer, tougher shell (chassisToughness), and a bar over your head with the roof down.
